defSrc: (of people and some animals) to move along, faster than walking, by taking quick steps in which each foot is lifted before the next foot touches the ground
If you run an animal in a race, you cause it to take part.

defSrc: to go quickly or in a hurry

defSrc: to run fast in order to get or avoid something

defSrc: to move your legs as if running, while you stay in one place
to (cause something to) travel, move, or continue in a particular way
defTgt: （使）行进，（使）行驶，（使）移动；（使）持续

defSrc: to (cause something to) operate
to be in control of something
to control a business or other organization firmly and effectively

defSrc: If you run a car, you own one, drive it, and pay for the costs.
to organize the way you live or work
